title: String Functions and Type Conversions
description: Clean, transform, and convert: case functions, substring, split/combine, prefix/suffix tests, regex replacement — plus ToInteger/ToDecimal/ToString and the ConvertsTo* checkers for safe parsing.
learningObjectives: Slice with Substring and measure with Length
Split strings and join lists with Combine
Convert types with ToInteger / ToDecimal / ToString

hints.message: Upper('hello') → 'HELLO'. CQL strings use single quotes.
ReplaceMatches(input, pattern, replacement) uses REGEX: ReplaceMatches('2024-03-01', '-', '/') → '2024/03/01'.
Split(s, sep) returns a LIST — wrap in First(...) to get one element.
Combine({'a','b','c'}, '-') joins a list with a separator: 'a-b-c'.
String functions accept FHIR fields: Upper(Patient.gender).
ToString(42) → '42' — any type can render as a string.
ToInteger('42') → 42 (Integer). Invalid strings return null, not an error.
ConvertsToInteger('42') → true — check before you convert.
ConvertsToInteger('3.5') → false — decimals are NOT integer-convertible (no truncation).
Components chain with conversions: ToString(year from Patient.birthDate.value) → '1990'.
